LIA43-21 LEAVING GPC FACILITY AND BRAKEMAN FORGOT TO LINE THE MAIN LINE SWITCH FOR MOVEMENT.  THEY THEN SHOVED BACK INTO GPC INSTEAD AND DERAILED.  GEORGIA PACIFIC CORP.  MAINTAINS TRACK.

YARDMASTER INTRUCTED Q36420 LOCOS TO PROCEED ON TRACK 1 AND CAUTIONING THAT THERE WAS A TRAIN AHEAD.CONDUCTOR OF Q36420 NOTICED CAR CUT IN FRONT OF THEM.  ENGINEER PUT TRAIN IN EMERGENCY BUT WAS UNABLE TO STOP PRIOR TO IMPACT.**

JOB 112 WAS HEADING SOUTH WITH 34 LOADS AND 29 EMPTIES.  A LOADED LOG TRUCK RAN INTO THE SIDE OF THE48TH CAR CAUSING TWO CARS TO DERAIL (TTGX 930553 & GACX 72887).  CAR NUMBER TTGX 930553 WAS KNOCKEDOUT OF THE BOWL.  IN ADDITION FOUR OTHER CARS WERE DAMAGED, BUT WERE NOT DERAILED.

YNA49-11 DERAILED 2 WEST CARS IN TRACK ACCOUNT WEST CAR AND WEST TRUCKS OF SECOND CAR HAD RUN THROUGH WEST SWITCH IN TRACK AND THEN MOVEMENT WAS MADE IN OPPOSITE DIRECTION RESULTING IN THE WEST 2 CARSIN TRACK DERAILING AND CAUSING WEST CAR IN ADJACENT TRACK TO DERAIL DUE TO BEING HIT BY DERAILED CARS.
Y30113 SHOVED A CUT OF CARS TO TRACK P08 AND THEN WENT TO TRACK P15. WHEN Y30113 WAS SHOVING BACK THE CARS IN TRACK P08 ROLLED OUT OF THE TRACK AND INTO THE SIDE OF THEIR TRAIN.^
ZKCPD-15 WAS WESTBOUND GOING INTO THE ADELAIDE SIDING AT 15 MPH AND DERAILED 9 ARTICULATED CARS DUETO A BROKEN SWITCH POINT CAUSED BY POOR RAIL AND SWITCH TIE CONDITION.

AC63 SHOVING OFF OF THE WEST PULLBACK TOWARDS FT06 DERAILED TBOX 644305 B END R4 WHEEL, TR 873631 BEND L 1-4 WHEELS AND R1, 3-4 WHEELS, TBOX 662012 ALL WHEELS, TBOX 670884 ALL WHEELS, HPJX 52393 ALLWHEELS, AND RTAX 19060 B END L/R 1&2 WHEELS.   TBOX 644305 AND TR 873631 CAME UNCOUPLED WHILE DRAGGING OUT OF CT35 UP THE WEST PULLBACK AND WHEN AC63 STARTED SHOVING OFF OF THE WEST PULLBACK TO FT06 THE CARS HAD A BYPASS COUPLING.
L SPR 6801 23, SOUTHBOUND AT THE SOUTH END OF CEDAR GAP, MO., FAILED TO COMPLY WITH STOP SIGNAL INDICATING STOP.
AMT540-07, CDTX8311 COLLIDED WITH UNOCCUPIED VEHICLE AT THE CROSSING. NO INJURIES. **AMT EQUIPMENT DAMAGES = $30,826.43 DOLLARS**
